title: Herbs for the hermit
What the woods give
summary: The hermit of {settlement} makes salves for whoever comes to him hurt. He is old and the woods are wide: bring him {count} × {item}.
offer: My knees will not carry me into the deep wood any more, and the salves will not make themselves. {count} × {item}, if you would. I will pay in what I have.
progress: The pot is empty, and someone always comes.
complete: Good. These will heal a good many hurts. Take this, it will heal yours.
